title: Golisano Children's Museum of Naples

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: to Golisano Children’s Museum of Naples (CMON) offer students a playful, hands-on learning experience rooted in STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math) education. Our 2.5-hour self-guided visits are ideal for schools, homeschool groups, and youth programs seeking a fun and educational day outside the classroom. Located in Naples, Florida, CMON is a top-rated field trip destination for children ages 2-12, blending exploration and education in an environment designed just for kids. services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Looking for a unique event venue in Naples, Florida?Play, learn, and imagine with your guests when you host your next private event at CMON. Our vibrant, interactive space offers a one-of-a-kind setting for everything from corporate events and meetings to birthday parties, cocktail receptions, nonprofit fundraisers, and more. Whether you’re planning an elegant evening soiree or a playful family celebration, CMON provides the perfect backdrop for guests of all ages. Enjoy the full run of interactive event space CMON has to offer, including our main floor exhibits, fine art, and a lush, green backyard area with an amphitheater and chalk wall.
